[[File:Tour_Guide_droid.png|thumb|right|200px|A [[Unidentified tour guide droid/Legends|tour guide droid]]]]
A '''tour guide''' was an individual who provided guidance to tourists. On [[Planet/Legends|planets]] where tourism was a major industry, many inhabitants might find profitable careers guiding tours, as was the case with the lush world of [[Carest 1]] and its natives, the [[Jiivahar]].<ref name="Alien Encounters">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> One Jiivahar tour guide, [[Jannpyr]], gained considerable fame.<ref name="SWAJ14">{{JournalCite|14|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref>

This occupation could also, in some instances, be performed by tour guide droids.<ref name="Shades of Reason">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref>
